Think step by step: first write down every fact you need and the document it comes from, then do the calculations, then compare. Then give the ANSWER line.
End your reply with exactly one final line in this format:
ANSWER: <district name or yes/no> | <number>
Write the number as a plain number (no units, no thousands separators), rounded to 3 decimal places.

Facts needed:
- Coldharbour (NR-12, 2025 profile): paved road 598.3 km; census population 2025 = 11,407.
- Stonecairn (NR-06, 2025 profile): paved road 506.8 km; census population 2025 = 14,926.

Neither district has a correction notice, and the profiles used are the 2025 ones, not the archived ones.

Calculations (km per 1,000 residents = km ÷ residents × 1,000):
- Coldharbour: 598.3 ÷ 11,407 × 1,000 = 52.4540... ≈ 52.454
- Stonecairn: 506.8 ÷ 14,926 × 1,000 = 33.9535... ≈ 33.954

Let me verify these more carefully:
- 598.3 / 11.407 = 52.45… (11.407 × 52 = 593.164; remainder 5.136; 5.136 / 11.407 ≈ 0.4502) → 52.4502
- 506.8 / 14.926 = 33.95… (14.926 × 33 = 492.558; remainder 14.242; 14.242 / 14.926 ≈ 0.9542) → 33.9542

Comparison: Coldharbour has more paved road per 1,000 residents. Difference = 52.4502 − 33.9542 = 18.4960 ≈ 18.496 km per 1,000 residents.

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 18.496
